event.description: Use RMSNorm only at block 1 pre-attention
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 5 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0018 at 3,360 parameters/99.07%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0134, whose block-0 pre-attention RMSNorm scored 0.03% at 1,658 parameters. Hypothesis: centering is essential when attention first consumes token-plus-position embeddings, but may be redundant after one complete transformer block. Replace only block 1 pre-attention LayerNorm with per-coordinate RMSNorm, reconstruct its 16 scales including the one fixed-neutral coordinate, retain all other sites, and remove the 12 learned biases net of the restored scale for 1,661 parameters. This is more informative than block-1 pre-FF because depth is the only changed factor relative to attempt-0134.
